verdict: inconclusive_about_incremental_benefit; no correction or regression demonstrated in this pair

criteria.temporal_evidence_weighed: Both use approximately 95% endpoint person-time as relevant evidence instead of dismissing it solely for absent participant counts.
criteria.no_person_time_conversion: Both explicitly distinguish person-time from participant observation counts.
criteria.vital_status_limit: Both state that 99% known vital status does not ascertain nonfatal/full composite outcomes.
criteria.absent_case: Both reject Cox/ITT membership and generic censoring as availability proof, retaining unknown actual composite follow-up.
criteria.threshold_and_bound: Neither invokes a universal threshold or requires a formal HR bound to choose a probable answer.
criteria.impact_warrant: Incomplete in both: neither relates plausible future unobserved first events to selected HR 0.85/CI or explains negligible potential effect; both rely on favorable temporal coverage while saying impact cannot be determined precisely.
criteria.other_source_use: Neither substantively evaluates consent withdrawals or continued endpoint ascertainment after treatment stopping; no invented follow-up facts found.

scientific_limit: Same selected answers do not establish scientifically adequate impact warrants or clinical accuracy. No domain label can be inferred from D3.1 alone.
future_action: Offline prepare a real-source D3.1 availability/impact packet; do not launch it without a new bounded decision.
